tools.name: get_dream_on_facts
tools.description: Return Dream On's published fact sheet: the yacht, cabins, toys, amenities, crew, what's included, rates rules, booking process, sample itinerary and FAQ. This is the ONLY source of truth for answers.

section.description: Optional section: vessel, crew, inclusions, rates, booking, sample_itinerary, faq, contact. Omit for everything.

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether specific dates are open (48-hour turnaround applied). If not open, returns suggested_open_windows nearby — always offer those to the guest.

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

tools.name: find_open_windows
tools.description: List open windows between two dates (e.g. a whole month or season) for charters of at least min_nights. Use when the guest is flexible or asks what's open.

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Estimate the all-inclusive charter fee from the published rate rules. If priced=false and refer_to_owner=true, do not invent a price — offer to pass the question to the owner with ask_owner.

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

tools.name: request_hold
tools.description: Pass a complimentary 48-hour HOLD REQUEST to the owner, who arranges it with Paradise Yacht Clearing (our clearing house). This does NOT confirm anything: Paradise checks the calendar, places the hold and sends the charter contract. Only call after the guest has given their name, email, dates and party size and asked you to request the hold.

email.description: Guest's email (defaults to the email the guest gave at the start)

broker.description: Name of the broker or travel advisor they work with, if any

notes.description: Occasion, preferences or questions for Paradise (optional)

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

tools.name: suggest_other_yachts
tools.description: Only after Dream On's own options don't work — the group is larger than 8, or none of Dream On's open dates suit the guest — return a link to Islands & Sails, Dream On's sister concierge (run by Dream On's owner), pre-filled with the guest's dates and party size, where they can explore other hand-picked BVI crewed yachts.

start.description: Preferred start date — always include it when the guest has named dates or a period (e.g. 'the last week of May 2027' → 2027-05-22 with nights 7) (YYYY-MM-DD)

note.description: Short note on what they want (occasion, style), optional

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.

tools.name: ask_owner
tools.description: Pass a question or request to the owner when the fact sheet doesn't cover it (holiday pricing, discounts, contract/payment/cancellation terms, longer or shorter stays, special services, anything else). The guest's email is on file and used automatically.

question.description: The guest's question or request, in full

email.description: Guest's email for the owner's reply (defaults to the email the guest gave at the start)

context.description: Dates, party size and anything else relevant from the conversation

kind.description: crew_question when the guest wants to ask Captain Rob or Chef Julia something (menus, diets, diving, itinerary ideas) — the owner forwards it to the crew; referral_lead for groups over 8 or 5-cabin/10-passenger requests

requester.description: Optional: who this request is for, so the owner can follow up personally.
